instruction: Capture the current frame in VLC and save it as an RGB PNG named 'frame_export.png' on the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting a video frame as an RGB PNG image. Evaluator verifies that the saved image has PNG format and RGB color mode. Verified from gold image: format='PNG', mode='RGB'. These are standard properties for video frame screenshots.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts image format and mode from the file at the expected path (/home/user/Desktop/frame_export.png)

Metric parameter handling is correct - when expected.type='rule', the framework calls get_rule() which returns config['rules'] directly, and the metric correctly accesses expected.get('format') and expected.get('mode')
Metric comparison logic is appropriate - checks both format (PNG) and mode (RGB) with equal weight (50% each), returns 0.0 for missing file, and 0.5 for partial match
Complete coverage of verifiable requirements - checks PNG format and RGB mode as specified in instruction
Expected values are semantically correct - format='PNG' and mode='RGB' match the instruction requirements
Edge cases handled properly - returns None if file doesn't exist or image is invalid, metric handles None result with 0.0 score
Data flow is correct - getter extracts the right state (image properties), metric compares the right aspects (format and mode), expected values match instruction
Practical feasibility confirmed - uses env.controller.get_file() to retrieve file from VM, PIL can read image properties, no postconfig needed as file persists after task completion
